units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 16:1">Sabb. XVI, 1</cite> <he>טעונים ג׳</he> must be removed (in case of their being unfit for use).

<cite ref="Megillah 26b:15">Meg. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>זו היא גְנִיזָתָן</he> this (their use for shrouds) is their removal.—[<cite ref="Pesachim 118b:20">Pes. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>בית גניזה</he>, v. <cite ref="C01122"><he>גֵּנֶז</he></cite>).
